text:
rachel: deploy-bot flagged the post-deploy prefill synthetic in eu-north at 02:15 as degraded (2/4 deadman fails) right after the rollout. canary at 8%. tagging eng-releases.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth eu-north prefill-check: deadman_threshold breached (2/4 fails). rolling forward paused. cohort: 8%. logs: /deploy/logs/1788888888/eu-north.

sre-bot: sampler: p95 jumped from 55ms -> 340ms for the failed window. interestingly, the synth shows probe timeouts clustered exactly at canary startup bursts. agent logs indicate aggressive prefill backoff after repeated miss detections (backoff factor x5).

omar: we shipped a backoff tweak to reduce hotspotting earlier today: prefill_backoff_multiplier default 5 -> 20 for new agents. looks like that made initial prefills wait too long when a few K/V misses occurred.

lina: can we confirm whether this is config vs model? run a quick curl against the canary host and against pinned baseline (model-v1.9) please.

rachel: curl outputs: canary host -> HTTP/2 200 x-probe-latency-ms: 412; pinned model host -> HTTP/2 200 x-probe-latency-ms: 62.

sre-bot: confirms. not model regression. mitigation plan proposal: 1) pause rollout & pin canary to 0% (rachel) 2) revert prefill_backoff_multiplier to 5 on canary IGs 3) trigger a targeted prefill on affected nodes and re-run synths 4) resume with slow ramp. rollback only if failures persist after prefills.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by rachel. canary set to 0%.

omar: applying config revert to canary IG now: `prefill_backoff_multiplier=5`. pushing change.

sre-bot: raising synthetic probe interval to 10s for 5m to reduce noisy retries while we warm.

(90s)

sre-bot: targeted prefill ran; re-run synth: 6/6 success, x-probe-latency-ms: ~68ms median. no further deadman hits.

lina: looks good. keep rollout paused and run a controlled ramp: 1% -> 3% -> 8% each 2m with manual checks. omar, please file a config rollback PR and a follow-up to make the backoff adaptive by canary cohort.

omar: filing PR now (ENG-5102) and creating a follow-up ENGR-5103 for adaptive backoff. notes: default multiplier back to 5; will add a canary-aware override.

rachel: release note snippet: "Post-deploy: transient synthetic prefill latency in eu-north caused by an overly aggressive prefill backoff config in the new agent. Mitigated by reverting config and triggering targeted prefill; rollout resumed with manual ramp. No customer impact."

(4 minutes pass)

lina: ramp at 8% now; synthetic checks passing across zones. leaving monitor at 10s window for 10m.

sre-bot: marking incident as triaged; follow-ups assigned to omar (config flag change) and eng-runtime (add canary-aware warmup tests).

rachel: closing thread after 30m of stable synths. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
